name: Multistep Lead Form
author: premiumplugin

sections.description:
The Multistep Lead Form plugin adds a powerful yet simple feature to WordPress: highly converting, conditional multi-step forms.

This plugin lets you build forms that are:
* Engaging with interactive icon and image choice cards
* Easy to build using a visual drag & drop editor
* Perfect for generating and managing leads directly in your dashboard

Features

  • Simple and intuitive drag & drop interface
  • Works seamlessly across desktop, tablet, and mobile
  • Built-in lead management system
  • Lightweight and secure — no external libraries
  • No performance impact or bloat
  • Developed by Premium Plugin (Premium-Plugin.com)

External services

This plugin uses Google reCAPTCHA v3 (if enabled in settings) to prevent spam submissions.
When reCAPTCHA is enabled, the plugin loads an external script from Google (https://www.google.com/recaptcha/api.js) and sends the user’s IP address and user agent to Google for verification during form submission (https://www.google.com/recaptcha/api/siteverify).

This service is provided by Google LLC:
* Terms of Service: https://policies.google.com/terms
* Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP via Plugins > Add New > Upload
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Go to Lead Forms > Add New
  4. Build your form and place the generated shortcode on any page or post
